cards.label: Camden
cards.text: A lock-up off the market that used to be Collective ground. Somebody's changed the padlock. Nobody saw it happen, or nobody's saying.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "That one's the Firm's now. Since sometime after Hakim. Nobody rang to tell us — we just noticed the takings stopped."
Two ways to have it back.

choices.label: Take it back
choices.result_text: You go in like it's still yours, because it still should be. Nobody's there to argue. That doesn't mean nobody notices.

choices.label: Buy it back
choices.result_text: "You want it back, that's a price, same as anyone's. We're not precious about it. It was never really ours, was it — three weeks in a ledger doesn't make it family." He counts it without looking up. It is the least interesting thing that has happened to him all week.

cards.text: Either way, the lock-up is yours again. Whether it feels like it is a separate question, for later.
